ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio with approximately 85% low-intensity (black) pixels across the primary surface and 15% high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated in scarring patterns.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation field acting as the background for high-contrast white geometric clusters. White pixels form discrete annular rings (rosettes) and vertical linear streaks distributed across both lobes, with higher spatial density near the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central depression manifests as a wide, obtuse V-shape with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 140-150 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency serration along the linear boundary; the topography consists of irregular pixel-level peaks and valleys across both lobes, notably more jagged on the outer margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical horizontal sweep with a slight convex curvature on the upper boundary leading toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white rings (consistent with barnacle attachment scars) localized on the outer lateral regions of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, non-aligned vertical and diagonal high-intensity white linear marks; a specific cluster of parallel vertical lines is detected on the medial-right lobe region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive surface trauma characterized by circular rosette scars and long-form linear scratches/rake marks that disrupt the uniform dark pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, fragmented pixel boundaries at the extreme left and right distal tips, indicating physical wear or tissue loss.
